enunciado: Diffusion language models generate text in arbitrary order and can generate multiple tokens simultaneously, bypassing the sequential constraint of autoregressive models
problema: Overcome the sequential bottleneck where N tokens require N forward passes in AR models
limite: Early diffusion models had lower quality than AR; quality improves with more steps
patron: A decoding procedure that can propose multiple output positions at once and refine them iteratively, starting from maximum uncertainty

concepto: Proceso adelante por enmascaramiento (Forward masking process)
enunciado: q(z_t^(i) | x^(i)) = α_t if z_t^(i) = x^(i), 1-α_t if z_t^(i) = M, where each position independently masks with probability 1-α_t
problema: Establish a known forward corruption process with analytically tractable posterior for learning its reverse
limite: Assumes position-wise independence; α_t must be a scalar parameter
patron: Independent binary masking controlled by a scheduling parameter that interpolates between fully clean and fully masked states

enunciado: For masked positions: P(z_s^(i) = x^(i) | z_t^(i) = M, x^(i)) = (α_s - α_t)/(1-α_t); revealed positions unchanged
problema: Define exact transition probabilities for the denoising process given noisy observations
limite: Requires knowledge of true clean text x; appears only as theoretical oracle
patron: A closed-form Bayesian posterior derived from Bayes rule that specifies exact unmasking probabilities based on signal level changes

concepto: Cota inferior de evidencia ponderada (Weighted ELBO)
enunciado: L_MDLM = E_{t~U(0,1), z_t~q(·|x)} [α_t'/(1-α_t) Σ_{i: z_t^(i)=M} -log x_θ^(i)(z_t, t)]
problema: Enable tractable training of discrete diffusion models without computing sequence likelihood
limite: Loss computed only at masked positions; weighting by unmasking probability
patron: A variational lower bound weighted by the derivative of signal level relative to noise, concentrating gradient on most informative timesteps

enunciado: For already-revealed positions, the Transformer outputs directly equal the inputs without modification; loss only on masked positions
problema: Simplify training by eliminating gradient computation on already-determined tokens
limite: Requires architectural support for copying; does not improve quality directly
patron: An identity-like operator that propagates known values unchanged while only computing predictions for unknowns

enunciado: Cache frozen Key and Value activations from previous decoding steps to avoid recomputation when sequence grows incrementally
problema: Reduce per-step computation cost in sequential generation
limite: Only compatible with causal attention; activations must be immutable to cache safely
patron: Memoization of attention subcomputations based on the assumption that past activations do not change

concepto: Tipo de mecanismo de atención (Attention mechanism type)
enunciado: Causal attention: each position depends only on left context; bidirectional attention: each position depends on entire context
problema: Trade off global context awareness against computability of KV cache
limite: Causal prevents true parallel generation; bidirectional prevents activation caching
patron: A masking operation on pairwise attention scores that enforces which positions can communicate, creating temporal or structural constraints

enunciado: At each step, rearrange sequence to place unmasked tokens on left, masked tokens on right, then apply causal attention on reordered positions
problema: Enable KV caching in parallel diffusion models by converting bidirectional dependencies into causal form
limite: Requires dynamic permutation each step; changes effective position embeddings
patron: Permute input to create artificial causality where known values precede unknowns, enabling cached computation without losing global modeling

enunciado: Initialize with full mask; loop: predict distributions for all masked positions, sample from distributions, keep fraction according to unmasking probability, remask others; repeat T times until all revealed
problema: Generate samples from a trained diffusion model while respecting the learned reverse process
limite: Quality degrades with fewer steps; different orderings of unmasking affect correlation structure
patron: Iterative refinement where each step proposes completions for all unknowns and probabilistically commits only to a stochastic subset

enunciado: α_t ∈ [0,1] controls corruption amount: α_t=1 corresponds to clean text, α_t=0 corresponds to fully masked sequence
problema: Parametrize the noise schedule in continuous-time diffusion models
limite: Usually defined as monotone decreasing function; linear schedule shown in examples
patron: A scalar parameter that interpolates between boundary conditions (pristine and maximally corrupted states) over a single dimension

enunciado: P(unmasking mask at position i in step s|t) = (α_s - α_t)/(1-α_t)
problema: Determine the fraction of masked tokens to reveal per denoising step
limite: Must have α_s > α_t; depends on schedule and timestep selection
patron: Rate-of-change weighting that normalizes signal change by current noise level, adapting reveal rate to corruption state

enunciado: Standard language modeling metric measuring average bits needed per token; exponentiated cross-entropy loss on held-out data
problema: Quantitatively measure language model quality and compare models on same benchmark
limite: Correlates with downstream performance but metric depends on data distribution; not directly comparable across datasets
patron: A scalar summary statistic derived from negative log-likelihood that concentrates on common errors

concepto: Límite de tiempo continuo (Continuous-time ELBO limit)
enunciado: As number of diffusion steps T → ∞, discrete Markov chain converges to continuous-time formulation; ELBO simplifies to the formula at line 221
problema: Simplify discrete diffusion theory by taking continuous limit for analytical tractability
limite: Approximation quality improves with larger T; requires differentiability assumptions on α_t schedule
patron: Replacing discrete summations with continuous integrals to obtain closed-form expressions with cleaner mathematical structure

enunciado: Set of solutions where no objective can be improved without worsening another; in generation, the curve of achievable (speed, quality) pairs
problema: Characterize fundamental, non-dominated trade-offs between conflicting optimization goals
limite: Achievable frontier depends on algorithm and implementation efficiency; may shift with hardware or algorithmic improvements
patron: A curve or surface in multi-dimensional objective space where improvement in one dimension necessitates sacrifice in another

concepto: Sesgo izquierda-derecha en datos (Left-to-right bias in data)
enunciado: Natural language has inherent temporal ordering from left to right; other discrete data structures (proteins, molecules) have no such directional bias
problema: Explain performance differences: why AR models excel at text but diffusion may excel at non-sequential discrete data
limite: Only applies to structured sequential data with directional information
patron: An inductive bias in data geometry that makes sequential generation easier than unordered generation for that domain

enunciado: Split sequence into fixed-size blocks; apply masked diffusion within each block; use autoregressive generation across block boundaries
problema: Enable partial KV caching in diffusion models by limiting bidirectional attention to block scope
limite: Quality degrades significantly when reducing diffusion steps per block; block boundaries create artificial constraints
patron: A hybrid approach layering local parallel generation with global sequential generation to achieve intermediate speed-quality tradeoff
